items.html: And afterwards, when the sins caused the First Temple to be destroyed, at the very time of the destruction, Malchut descended behind the Yesod of ZA. However, her upper ten Sefirot did not descend into the Klipot, as was at the sin of the first man, but ascended above, within ZA, into their roots, as above in the matter of the waning of the moon. And had this great diminution not been made, the Klipot and the nations of the world would not have had the ability to destroy the Holy Temple. However, the upper ten Sefirot returned to become hidden above, in ZA, and the Klipot did not rule over them.
